## Line 124

```plato

//==
// # Polygon-derived solids

// The solid swept by translating Base along Offset: a general prism
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prism_(geometry)). Oblique when Offset is not
// perpendicular to the base plane; convex when the base is convex.
// NOT Deformable3D: the type stores a sweep VECTOR, and a point mapping has no
// principled action on a vector — the image of a translational sweep under a
// nonlinear mapping is not a translational sweep.
type Prism3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IVolume, IBounded3D, ICentroid3D, IContainsPoint3D
{
    Base: Polygon3D;
    Offset: Vector3D;
}
```
